chatgptPrompt: Create a Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: three round raindrops of different sizes falling in a column under a small soft cloud, each followed by faint ghost stamps whose spacing grows and then stays constant, a thin height ladder at the left. Composition: three drops in a vertical frame, cloud at the top, ladder on the left. Lighting and treatment: soft daylight and a pale sky; a daylight lab or an everyday room, clean and exact, cream background #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, one blue #2F5BFF accent, soft strobe-ghost stamps, premium editorial science documentary look, clearly a code-rendered illustration rather than a photograph. Mood: wonder. Text: No text. Scientific accuracy: a falling raindrop reaches a steady top speed because air drag equals its weight; bigger drops fall faster; real raindrops are not teardrop shaped. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph or a news image. Style: distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point and any text inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25% and the right-hand buttons.
